verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Claude Design can apply a team's design system for consistency and import existing components, but there is no evidence of a native component/variant/instance model with per-instance overrides that stay linked to a source component. The one mention of 'reusable components and design system tokens' is achieved by piping output through a third-party tool (PenPot) via MCP, not a native Claude Design feature. Missing for 10: native variant/instance system, per-instance override UI, linked-to-source update propagation, first-party documentation of this component model.
